name: Spirit-Sister's Call — the returned card gains the quoted ability
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). "… return the chosen card from your graveyard to the battlefield and it gains "…"" produced nothing: "the chosen card" was not read as a card being moved. The fired text now reads "Target permanent gains "…""; the returned card is added by hand and picked (here an artifact, since any permanent card can be chosen).

$includes: If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
